<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AccordionRootEmits, AccordionRootProps } from "reka-ui"
import {
  AccordionRoot,
  useForwardPropsEmits,
} from "reka-ui"

/**
 * Accordion 的 props 声明；透传第三方 primitive 的字段时只在本地补充 class、variant 或默认值约束。
 */
const props = defineProps<AccordionRootProps>()
/**
 * Accordion 的事件声明；事件名称和载荷保持与底层 primitive 或本地交互状态一致。
 */
const emits = defineEmits<AccordionRootEmits>()

/**
 * 转发 Accordion 的 props 和事件，确保包装组件继续兼容 reka-ui 的受控与非受控行为。
 */
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits)
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionRoot v-bind="forwarded">
    <slot />
  </AccordionRoot>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AccordionItemProps } from "reka-ui"
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { reactiveOmit } from "@vueuse/core"
import { AccordionItem, useForwardProps } from "reka-ui"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/**
 * AccordionItem 的 props 声明；透传第三方 primitive 的字段时只在本地补充 class、variant 或默认值约束。
 */
const props = defineProps<AccordionItemProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()

/**
 * 移除仅由 AccordionItem 本地消费的字段，避免 class、variant 等样式字段透传到底层 DOM 或 primitive。
 */
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class")

/**
 * 转发 AccordionItem 的 props 和事件，确保包装组件继续兼容 reka-ui 的受控与非受控行为。
 */
const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(delegatedProps)
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionItem
    v-bind="forwardedProps"
    :class="cn('border-b', props.class)"
  >
    <slot />
  </AccordionItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { AccordionTriggerProps } from "reka-ui"
import type { HTMLAttributes } from "vue"
import { reactiveOmit } from "@vueuse/core"
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-vue-next"
import {
  AccordionHeader,
  AccordionTrigger,
} from "reka-ui"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

/**
 * AccordionTrigger 的 props 声明；透传第三方 primitive 的字段时只在本地补充 class、variant 或默认值约束。
 */
const props = defineProps<AccordionTriggerProps & { class?: HTMLAttributes["class"] }>()

/**
 * 移除仅由 AccordionTrigger 本地消费的字段，避免 class、variant 等样式字段透传到底层 DOM 或 primitive。
 */
const delegatedProps = reactiveOmit(props, "class")
</script>

<template>
  <AccordionHeader class="flex">
    <AccordionTrigger
      v-bind="delegatedProps"
      :class="
        cn(
          'flex flex-1 items-center justify-between py-4 font-medium transition-all hover:underline [&[data-state=open]>svg]:rotate-180',
          props.class,
        )
      "
    >
      <slot />
      <slot name="icon">
        <ChevronDown
          class="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 transition-transform duration-200"
        />
      </slot>
    </AccordionTrigger>
  </AccordionHeader>
</template>

/**
 * 导出 Accordion 组件，保持 shadcn-vue 的按目录导入约定。
 */
export { default as Accordion } from "./Accordion.vue"
/**
 * 导出 AccordionContent 组件，保持 shadcn-vue 的按目录导入约定。
 */
export { default as AccordionContent } from "./AccordionContent.vue"
/**
 * 导出 AccordionItem 组件，保持 shadcn-vue 的按目录导入约定。
 */
export { default as AccordionItem } from "./AccordionItem.vue"
/**
 * 导出 AccordionTrigger 组件，保持 shadcn-vue 的按目录导入约定。
 */
export { default as AccordionTrigger } from "./AccordionTrigger.vue"
